nodes.description: Mapping of reflection balances per address; mutated by _transferStandard and _takeTeam.
Nested mapping of spender allowances; written in _approve and read by transferFrom.
Mapping of addresses exempt from fees; set in constructor.
Blacklist mapping controlling transfer eligibility; set by nonosquare/delBot, read in _transfer.
Per-address cooldown timestamp, written using block.timestamp inside _transfer.
Total reflections supply; reduced inside _reflectFee.
Accumulated token fees; increased inside _reflectFee.
Tax fee percentage used by _getValues; set in _transfer.
Team fee percentage used by _getValues; set in _transfer.
Fee recipient wallet 1, also used as the privileged caller in manualswap/manualsend.
Fee recipient wallet 2 receiving ETH in sendETHToFee.
Uniswap V2 router instance used for swaps and liquidity operations.
Token/ETH pair address created in openTrading and referenced in _transfer.
Trading activation flag toggled in openTrading.
Reentrancy guard flag for the swap path, set by the lockTheSwap modifier.
Enables automatic swap of contract tokens in _transfer.
Enables the per-address cooldown check in _transfer.
Maximum transfer amount enforced when cooldown is active.
Ownership variable of Ownable, set in constructor and cleared in renounceOwnership.
Public ERC20 transfer; forwards to _transfer with msg.sender.
Public ERC20 transferFrom; calls _transfer then _approve to reduce allowance.
Public ERC20 approve; delegates to _approve with msg.sender.
Core transfer routine: bot checks, cooldown with block.timestamp, fee settings, swap-and-send ETH path.
Swaps contract token balance for ETH through the router; guarded by lockTheSwap.
Splits contract ETH balance between the two fee wallets via low-level ETH transfers.
Owner-only initialization of router, pair and liquidity; enables swap/cooldown and sets max tx.
Owner-only bulk blacklisting of addresses into the bots mapping.
Owner-only removal of an address from the bot blacklist.
Internal indirection that dispatches to _transferStandard.
Applies reflection balance updates and fee/team accounting for a transfer.
Mints reflection balance to the contract for the team fee.
Reduces _rTotal and increases _tFeeTotal by the fee amounts.
Manual swap of contract tokens guarded only by a msg.sender equality check against _feeAddrWallet1.
Manual distribution of contract ETH guarded only by a msg.sender equality check against _feeAddrWallet1.
Computes t/r transfer, fee and team values via _getTValues, _getRValues and _getRate.
Derives token fee and team amounts by multiplying and dividing by 100.
Derives reflection amounts from token amounts using the current rate.
Computes the reflection rate as rSupply divided by tSupply.
Returns current r/t supply pair with a division guard against _rTotal/_tTotal.
Owner-only ownership renouncement clearing _owner.
Owner-only toggling of the cooldownEnabled flag.
Converts a reflection amount to a token amount using the current rate.
Internal allowance writer with zero-address checks.
Returns the token balance derived from the stored reflection balance.
Deploys the token, sets fee wallets, excludes addresses from fees and assigns total reflections.
Caller-controlled address used for auth checks, owner assignment and transfer initiation.
Miner-influenced timestamp used for cooldown logic and Uniswap deadlines.
Transaction origin; not consumed by this contract.
Native ETH send to _feeAddrWallet2 using address.transfer, forwarding 2300 gas.
Native ETH send to _feeAddrWallet1 using address.transfer, forwarding 2300 gas.
External call to uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens; control returns to third-party contracts.
External payable call to uniswapV2Router.addLiquidityETH during openTrading.
Division operations in fee/rate math; potential division-by-zero or rounding loss.
SafeMath subtraction reducing _rTotal inside _reflectFee.

edges.reason: transfer uses the caller address as the transfer origin.
transferFrom uses the caller as spender for allowance deduction.
approve passes the caller as owner into _approve.
_transfer receives the caller-controlled from address.
openTrading is guarded by onlyOwner comparing msg.sender with _owner.
nonosquare is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
delBot is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
manualswap is authorized solely by msg.sender equality with _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend is authorized solely by msg.sender equality with _feeAddrWallet1.
renounceOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner.
setCooldownEnabled is guarded by onlyOwner.
Constructor writes the caller into _owner, granting owner privileges.
Cooldown window is stored and compared against block.timestamp.
Swap deadline is supplied from block.timestamp.
Liquidity deadline in openTrading uses block.timestamp.
transfer delegates execution to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates execution to _transfer.
transferFrom reduces allowance through _approve.
approve delegates to _approve.
_transfer finalizes by calling _tokenTransfer.
_transfer triggers a token-to-ETH swap while the transfer is still executing.
_transfer sends out ETH via sendETHToFee in the same transaction.
_transfer writes the cooldown timestamp for the recipient.
_transfer enforces the maximum transfer amount.
_transfer reads the bot blacklist to gate transfers.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard accounts for the team fee via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard reflects the fee via _reflectFee.
_transferStandard obtains amounts from _getValues.
_transferStandard debits the sender reflection balance.
_takeTeam credits the contract reflection balance.
Fee reflection is applied by subtracting from the total reflections.
The subtraction writes the reduced _rTotal.
_reflectFee accumulates the token fee total.
swapTokensForEth performs an external router swap call with fee-on-transfer semantics.
The external swap call can re-enter the token transfer path before state is finalized.
swapTokensForEth approves the router through _approve.
swapTokensForEth reads the configured router address.
sendETHToFee pushes ETH to the second fee wallet.
sendETHToFee pushes ETH to the first fee wallet.
ETH is transferred to _feeAddrWallet2.
ETH is transferred to _feeAddrWallet1.
openTrading sets the router instance.
openTrading stores the created pair address.
openTrading adds liquidity through an external payable router call.
openTrading flips the tradingOpen flag.
openTrading enables automatic swapping.
openTrading enables cooldown enforcement.
openTrading sets the maximum transaction amount.
nonosquare writes blacklist entries into the bots mapping.
delBot clears blacklist entries from the bots mapping.
setCooldownEnabled toggles the cooldown flag.
tokenFromReflection obtains the rate from _getRate.
balanceOf converts reflections through tokenFromReflection.
tokenFromReflection bounds-checks the amount against _rTotal.
_getValues derives token values from _getTValues.
_getValues derives reflection values from _getRValues.
_getValues obtains the current rate.
_getTValues divides fee numerators by 100.
_getRValues performs subtractions on derived reflection amounts.
_getRate reads supplies from _getCurrentSupply.
_getCurrentSupply reads _rTotal for the supply check.
_getCurrentSupply divides _rTotal by _tTotal in its guard.
_getRate basis derives from the total reflections supply.
_approve writes the allowance mapping.
manualswap invokes the token-to-ETH swap on the whole contract balance.
manualsend invokes ETH distribution to the fee wallets.
Constructor seeds the caller reflection balance with _rTotal.
Constructor assigns fee wallet 1.
Constructor assigns fee wallet 2.
Constructor sets _owner through the ownable initialization.
Constructor marks owner, contract and fee wallets as fee-exempt.
renounceOwnership clears the owner address variable.

normalization_plan.reason: recipient parameter is fully consumed by transfer and carries no independent state.
amount parameter only exists for the transfer call.
sender parameter is only meaningful inside transferFrom.
recipient parameter is only meaningful inside transferFrom.
amount parameter is only used for the transferFrom flow.
spender parameter is bound to the approve entry point.
amount parameter is bound to the approve entry point.
from parameter defines the source of the internal transfer logic.
to parameter defines the destination of the internal transfer logic.
amount parameter drives the cooldown and swap branches in _transfer.
tokenAmount parameter is consumed only by the swap routine.
amount parameter is only split inside sendETHToFee.
bots_ array exists only for the blacklist loop.
notbot parameter exists only for the blacklist removal.
sender parameter is consumed by the reflection accounting.
recipient parameter is consumed by the reflection accounting.
tAmount parameter feeds the value derivation.
tTeam parameter is only used to mint the team reflection.
rFee parameter is only used to reduce total reflections.
tFee parameter is only used to raise the fee total.
tAmount parameter is the sole input of the value derivation helper.
rAmount parameter is only validated and divided inside the conversion helper.
account parameter is only used to index the reflection balance.
owner parameter indexes the allowance mapping in _approve.
spender parameter indexes the allowance mapping in _approve.
amount parameter is the allowance value written by _approve.
currentRate is a transient rate value produced by the rate helper.
contractTokenBalance exists only inside the _transfer swap branch.
contractETHBalance exists only inside the _transfer ETH distribution branch.
path is a transient swap route constructed for the router call.
rAmount is a transient reflection value produced by _getRValues.
taxFee parameter is only used to scale the fee within _getTValues.
TeamFee parameter is only used to scale the team amount within _getTValues.
currentRate parameter is only used to convert token values into reflections.
